tour_blurb: Welcome to the Tower. Iris keeps the lobby — she greets every visitor, signs them in, and routes them to the right lift. If you have a question and you're not sure where it belongs, start here. Iris will hand you off to the floor that owns the answer.

live_signals.iris_greeting_sample: Welcome to Skyscraper HQ run by AI. My name's Iris, the front-desk receptionist on Floor Zero. How can I help you today?

lessons_learned_for_next_agent: F0 /api/f0/converse requires a 'text' field in the JSON body — calling it with only caller_id returns 400, which is a schema failure, not an unhealthy endpoint. Always probe live with the documented payload shape before declaring an endpoint down.

team_roster.role: owns floor: keeps room schema current, tracks worker headcount, stamps daily activity, escalates to Wren+Hermes
